monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The home-testing guide adds a high-intent, product-neutral conversion path with a system-evidence packet, claim screen, first-year and valid-result cost formulas, three-option worksheet, rejection gates, and contextual links into existing gear and laboratory-evidence resources. No merchant, product, model, price, coupon, ranking, product image, review claim, or affiliate link was added.

image_qa.note: The home-testing framework, publisher-methodology record, and collection schemas use semantic text, tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No editorial, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 21–October 18 report showed 1,093 impressions, three clicks, 0.274% CTR, and average position 19.199. No query or page met a credible new reinforcement threshold after the October 15 Stem Cell CBG expansion and October 23 sitemap-integrity fix, so no item is primarily Data-led. Stem Cell CBG at 19 impressions, one click, and position 6.0 was deliberately not reinforced again; Blue Dream at 13 impressions around position 47.6, Montana cannabis at two impressions, one-impression legal rows, and About/Contact navigational impressions were ignored as too weak, too low-ranking, or irrelevant to a new editorial cluster. The batch therefore uses verified evergreen evidence while strengthening discovery and trust.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy consumer measurement-system guide grounded in NIST cannabis laboratory quality-assurance work and New York OCM sampling and laboratory standards, with a decision matrix, system-evidence packet, sampling record, performance-claim screen, quality-control questions, total-cost worksheet, licensed-lab trigger, and auditable result record. The About page now exposes ownership, sourcing, review, correction, commercial, testing, and automation boundaries. Reciprocal links strengthen the certificate, contaminant, visual-inspection, and gear-comparison cluster. No outreach was sent and no marginal opportunity was logged.
